script: My heart shattered when cops raided our home—he was arrested for trafficking minors.. I was 32, living with my boyfriend of 11 years, the same apartment, the same pet, the same engagement ring on my finger, the same holiday plans. Then Wednesday morning, a knock. Plain‑clothes police, looking for him. Half of them tried to arrest him at his job, the others just kept calling for more detectives. They asked if his job involved under‑18s. I felt like someone had punched me in the gut. They snatched all his electronics, searched my phone, then dragged me through every cupboard, under the sofa, for hours. He'd been online talking about the worst stuff involving kids. He had nieces and nephews. We had a future. I kept throwing up. They let him go, but he never told me what he'd done. The warrant said enough for me to know I was done with him. He was a coward, never spilling the tea. The detectives said it had been going on for years. All our good memories got tainted. Now I am wondering what he was doing on his phone or who he was talking to. (I know, right?) I don't know how to rebuild my life. I took the pet and stayed with a friend. I am looking for somewhere else to live, but I am scared of the tenancy agreement if he doesn't agree to leave. I want to rip my skin off, the fact he was doing those things and then coming to bed with me. I've barely slept or eaten since. I can't think about anything else, or how I am supposed to go on. Update: I went back to the flat to pack, and he was waiting for an ambulance because he felt suicidal. Things escalated, and now he'll have a common assault charge against me added to the investigation. I've been advised to stay away as long as possible and maybe move into a women's refuge for my safety. Through a long chat with some specialist police officers, it turned out to be an abusive relationship I didn't see as such. They'll now investigate him for domestic abuse and sexual assault of me. My friends are fantastic, but I am still struggling to see a way forward. He's a monster, and I had no idea. Thank you all for your kind comments. I know none of this is my fault logically. Emotionally it's another matter. But I am safe, and he doesn't know where I am.
